trade.text: She says she would remove tariffs on critical farm inputs to lower costs.
trade.quote: Remove tariffs on critical farm inputs to lower costs.

housing.text: She says increasing the housing supply is an important part of addressing housing affordability.
housing.quote: increasing the supply of homes is an important part of the solution.

schools.text: She opposed proposed federal cuts to South Dakota public education.
schools.quote: These draconian cuts to public education put the future of South Dakota’s children on the line.

abortion.text: She says bodily autonomy requires keeping government out of the doctor's office and supports reproductive health access.
abortion.quote: I also believe that without bodily autonomy, your right to keep the Government out of the doctor's office becomes null & void.

health.text: She supports protecting Medicare and Medicaid, expanding Medicare for nursing-home funding, and restoring Marketplace tax credits.
health.quote: We can make health care affordable by protecting Medicare, Medicaid, and restoring the Marketplace tax credits that keep private market coverage in reach for thousands of South Dakotans.

voting.text: She supports accommodations for in-person and mail-in voting and criticized federal action restricting mail voting.
voting.quote: Supporting the need for accommodations to be made for in-person and mail-in voting.

tax.text: In announcing his congressional campaign, Jackley said he would work to reduce government and cut taxes.
tax.quote: reduce the size of government, and cut taxes for hard working Americans.

safety.text: Jackley said he supports law enforcement and identified public safety as a priority for Congress.
safety.quote: I am standing behind him to support law enforcement and keep our country safe.

immigration.text: Jackley said he worked to secure the southern border and has backed border security as a congressional priority.
immigration.quote: I have worked with President Trump to secure our southern border, stop the flow of dangerous drugs into our communities

guns.text: Jackley’s campaign described his record as defending the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: Jackley has a proven conservative record defending life, the 2nd Amendment, and property rights.
